Assets.DESCRIPTION[UbPr_ElementarySchool: A compact, urban school of basic education for children with extra range and capacity. Provides the first level of education. Can be upgraded with an extension wing and a rooftop playground.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[UbPr_Elementa: More space for more pupils and a hangout terrace on the second floor.
The activities provided on the rooftop playground includes hopscotch and a nice skyline view, which increases well-being to citizens.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[UbPr_HighSchool01]: A compact, urban school for teenagers. Provides the second level of education. Can be upgraded with an extension wing and a gym including a pool and a basketball court.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[UbPr_HighScho: The school is enlarged by multiple levels, doubling capacity to make room for more students while maintaining the overall compact footprint. Adds a roof terrace.
Including a pool and a basketball court, this is the perfect place for students and surrounding citizens to improve on their health.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[UbPr_MedicalCenter01]: A medium-sized healthcare facility that provides health care for a large area and takes care of sick and injured citizens. Keeps citizens in its service area healthier. Can be upgraded with specialized clinics and an underground ambulance depot.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[UbPr_MedicalC: Specialized treatment helps citizens in the Urban Medical Center's service area remain healthier.
A space-saving underground depot adding several additional ambulances.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[UbPr_PoliceHQ01]: A large urban police headquarter with administrative and staff facillities and a jail. Can be upgraded with an extended underground garage and a helipad.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[UbPr_PoliceHQ: Placed on the rooftop terrace, police helicopters operating from here patrol the city from the skies. They can cover larger areas and respond faster than patrol cars.
More underground space for police vehicles.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[UbPr_FireHouse01]: A medium-sized urban station that houses several fire engines. Also reduces the likelihod of fires in the buildings in its service area by conducting safety supervision. A training tower and a disaster response unit.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[UbPr_FireHous: Specialized office space to coordinate rescue services within the service range.
On-site training facilitiy specializing in urban environments that help firefighters stay in top shape and thus extinguish fires more efficiently.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[UbPr Residential Mixe: Apartment buildings with commercial space on the bottom and apartments on top. Each building a rooftop terrace and an Urban Promenade. The Urban Promenade has extra space extending the sidewalk, trees planters, more walking space and urban seating.
